from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# Table in obs_0016:
# Bottom of legs:
arr16 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0016.png"))
# legs color:
legs = (arr16[:, :, 0] > 70) & (arr16[:, :, 0] < 120) & (arr16[:, :, 1] > 30) & (arr16[:, :, 1] < 70) & (arr16[:, :, 2] < 30)
y16, x16 = np.where(legs)
# bottom y of table legs:
print("obs_0016 table bottom_y:", y16.max())

# Pose 16: (-0.750, 0.933), heading 90 (+x)
# D = 256 * 1.55 / (y16.max() - 255.5)
D16 = 256 * 1.55 / (y16.max() - 255.5)
print(f"Table forward distance from pose 16: {D16:.3f}")
# In pose 16 (heading 90 = +x):
# x_table = -0.750 + D16
# y_table = 0.933 - (mean_x - 255.5)/256 * D16
# Let get mean_x of the table top / center:
# table top was in x in [138, 274], center ~ 206
cx = 206.0
y_table = 0.933 - (cx - 255.5) / 256 * D16
print(f"Table position: x = {-0.750 + D16:.3f}, y = {y_table:.3f}")
'
